summary: Verified tablet-source isolation across admin listing + stats endpoints and Admin → Ventes tablette UI. Inserted TEST web (no order_source) and TEST tablet (order_source='tablet') delivery orders directly into MongoDB with unique order_number, exercised endpoints, and cleaned up unconditionally. UI smoke on desktop (1920) and mobile (390) both pass with no horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: /api/admin/stats/tablet excludes docs with test_order=True but /api/admin/stats does NOT filter test_order for the non-tablet branch — asymmetry could inflate main revenue if any historic test orders exist. Consider adding {'test_order': {'$ne': True}} on admin_stats for consistency with delivery-fees stats.
Direct-insert path requires an order_number for the unique index (order_number_1). Existing seeding code should ensure this field is always present to avoid duplicate-null-key insert failures.
server.py is 1875 lines — consider splitting into routers (admin_orders, admin_stats, tablet) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Inserted 2 TEST-prefixed orders (WEB + TABLET) directly via pymongo; deleted unconditionally in fixture finally block. No POST /orders, no kitchen/printer/tablet-order endpoint calls.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable regression test at /app/backend/tests/test_tablet_isolation.py. Run with: python -m pytest backend/tests/test_tablet_isolation.py -v -o addopts=''. All TEST_TABLET_ISOL_* docs are cleaned in finally. UI page /admin/tablet-orders is stable with data-testid coverage (tablet-orders-admin-page, tablet-orders-kpi-*, tablet-orders-empty, tablet-orders-delivery-count, tablet-orders-pickup-count). Do NOT invoke test_kitchen_flow.py or any printer/tablet-order POST endpoints.
